import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String email = scanner.nextLine();
        email = solve(email);
        System.out.println(email);
        scanner.close();
    }

    public static String solve(String email) {
        int at_pos = email.indexOf("at", 1);
        if (at_pos != -1) {
            email = email.substring(0, at_pos) + "@" + email.substring(at_pos + 2);
        }
        int pos = email.indexOf("dot", 1);
        while (pos != -1 && email.length() != pos + 3) {
            email = email.substring(0, pos) + "." + email.substring(pos + 3);
            pos = email.indexOf("dot", 1);
        }
        return email;
    }
}
